brief: Two-storey Italianate brick house completed about 1875 for a carpet merchant: bracketed cornice, tall 2/2 windows with hoods, a slim three-storey entrance tower with a hipped cap, and a bay window on the side. Record gap: no photographs; 5 measured drawing sheets (site plan, plans, elevations, cornice and window details).

facade.notes: HABS site plan and text: the James Ward House (Lafayette, 1875), Italianate with a Second Empire touch -- 'the asymmetrical design ... a tower and a projecting bay, tall narrow windows, the round-arched door, the eaves supported by brackets, and the picturesque porch'; the tower has a mansard roof. The site plan shows a corner lot with the house set forward, a drive to a rear outbuilding, trees along the lot lines

why.note: a carpet merchant's 1870s Italianate house: brackets, tower, bay
